question.worked_solution:
We first need to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder parts, which we can do using synthetic division.

We draw up a synthetic division table:

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}^{3} & {x}^{2} & {x}^{1} & {x}^{0} \\ 3 & 3 & -2 & 0 & -21 \\  & ↓ & 9 & 21 & 63 \\  & 3 & 7 & 21 & 42\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\frac{3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-21}{x-3}=3{x}^{2}+7x+21+\frac{42}{x-3}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-21}{x-3}\,\text{d}x & =3\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x+7\int x\,\text{d}x+21\int \text{d}x+42\int \frac{1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={x}^{3}+\frac{7}{2}{x}^{2}+21x+42\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-3|+C.\end{aligned}
$$
